entities.name: Merret
entities.description: Dockworker and covert agent for House Dimir with a magically gifted son.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: Secretive Ravnican guild Merret works for.

entities.name: Tashi
entities.description: Merret's wife, who makes minor healing salves.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: Dimir leader who took an interest in Merret's magical child.

entities.name: Aunt Bea
entities.description: Secret Dimir agent installed in Merret's home to care for the boy.

entities.name: Merritson
entities.description: Merret's magical child, kept under Lazav's protection after the War of the Spark.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: War after which Merritson remained under Lazav's protection.

events.summary: Merret clears fog from the harbor on his boss's orders, revealing a Simic schooner that turns invisible.
events.quote: Merret managed to clear the fog just enough to reveal a Simic schooner

events.summary: Merret breaks into his boss's home, steals bread and drinks an Elixir of Focus, then escapes invisibly.
events.quote: drank an Elixir of Focus, which heightened his magical abilities

events.summary: Grimbly discovers Merret's baby's magic and tries to take the child; the baby vanishes and reappears with a mysterious fruit.
events.quote: Grimbly stormed in, discovered the baby's newfound magical abilities, and attempted to take the child.

events.summary: Lazav reveals himself, lets the parents raise the boy under safeguards, sends Grimbly away with memory erased and installs Aunt Bea.
events.quote: Suddenly, Lazav revealed himself from the corner where he had been sitting all along.

events.summary: Merret's and Tashi's memories are altered to accept Bea as family.
events.quote: Merret and Tashi's memories were also altered to forget the altercation with Grimbly

relations.quote: deeply committed to his wife, Tashi, and their children
His boss, Grimbly Wothis , ordered him to clear the fog
Lazav installed a secret Dimir agent named "Aunt Bea"
The child was later named Merritson
